headline: Shadab Khan's unbeaten 113 off 96 balls led Pakistan to a one-wicket win over England in the ODI tri-series match in Lahore, booking Pakistan's place in the final.

card.desc: Shadab's unbeaten 113 off 96 balls seals tri-series final spot.

caption:
Shadab Khan hit an unbeaten 113 off 96 balls, his maiden ODI century, as Pakistan beat England by one wicket in Lahore to reach the tri-series final, Geo News reports. Pakistan were 154-9 chasing 242 before Shadab and Haris Rauf added an unbeaten 89 for the last wicket, Dawn adds.
